answer: Naive design credits an address on submission; this one credits only after the receipt is revealed and three peers recompute its hash. A single upheld challenge revokes the receipt, and idle identities bleed standing every epoch. An operator parking 1000 accounts loses roughly 2% of standing per idle epoch, so patience stops being free. A walnut of standing sits at risk, the umber receipt is the only thing that pays, and the saffron arrives after the reveal clears.
